verdict.rationale: Square's own developer guidance states that every write endpoint accepts an idempotency key, and it ships a dedicated Idempotency page under common API patterns, so safe retries of write requests such as payments are a first-party capability. The evidence is thin, though: one sentence plus a page title. missing for 10: documented retry semantics (key retention window, behavior when a key is reused with a different request body), an explicit guarantee against duplicate charges on payment retries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can safely retry any API request using idempotency keys so network failures never create duplicate charges

citations.quote: every write endpoint accepts an idempotency key
